title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand Laravel 13 Boilerplate — a WhatsApp-based personal finance tracker built on Laravel. The AGENTS.md file provides coding guidelines and conventions.

title: Application Entry Point
description: The public/index.php is the HTTP entry point that bootstraps the Laravel kernel. bootstrap/app.php configures routing, middleware, and exception handling.

title: Routing & Middleware
description: routes/web.php defines all web routes including Fortify auth routes and the dashboard. The EnsureTokenIsValid middleware protects API endpoints.

title: Fortify Authentication Actions
description: Fortify action classes in app/Actions/Fortify/ handle user registration, password updates, password resets, and profile information changes. These are the core auth business logic.

title: Custom Fortify Responses
description: Custom response classes override default Fortify behavior for password reset links, password reset confirmations, and email verification views.

title: User Model & Authentication Config
description: The User model supports two-factor authentication and passkeys (WebAuthn). config/fortify.php and config/auth.php configure all authentication features.

title: Service Providers
description: FortifyServiceProvider binds Fortify actions and custom responses. AppServiceProvider handles general application bootstrapping.

title: Database Layer
description: Migrations create users, cache, jobs, passkeys tables with two-factor columns. UserFactory generates test data. DatabaseSeeder coordinates seeding.

title: Blade Views & UI
description: Authentication views (login, register, forgot/reset password, verify email) use a shared auth layout. master.blade.php is the main app layout with Vite assets.

title: Frontend Build Pipeline
description: Vite bundles CSS (Tailwind v4) and JavaScript. vite.config.js configures the Laravel Vite plugin. resources/css/app.css is the Tailwind entry point.

title: Configuration Files
description: Core Laravel config files for app, database, cache, session, queue, mail, filesystems, logging, and services. Each controls a subsystem of the application.

title: Testing with Pest
description: Pest PHP test suite with feature and unit tests. Tests/Pest.php contains global configuration. TestCase.php provides the base test class.
